en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2451 - It is narrated from Nasr, the servant, who said:

The righteous servant (of Allah (swt)), Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), looked at a provision container with brass rings and said:
"Remove these and replace them with iron, for nothing harmful will approach anything contained within it."
